question: The hills of the northeast are called _____.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Purvanchal__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fed23cf83dbb708fc244a9fb2551a628789543fa05ad81abd91932195698c9cd.png] 

__
 
• Hills including Mishmi, **Naga, Manipur, Tripura, Mizo, Patkai** that run through the **north-east region** are known as **Purvanchal Hills**.
 
• It lies **south of the Brahmaputra valley**.
 
• It covers an area of about **94,800 km².**
 
• It covers **Nagaland, Manipur, Tripura, and Mizoram Hills**, and Chachar Districts along with a fifth of **Haflong tahsil of** **Assam **State and District of Tripa and part of **Lohit in Arunachal Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharamputra River enters first** in **Namchafarua mountain** in **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• **Majuli Island in Assam is the world's largest river island.**
 
• **Tributaries** of **Bharamputra **are - **Manas, Tista**, **Jamuna**, **Dihand, Dibang**, Kemeng, etc.
 
• **Cities alongside the river Bharamputra** are - **Guwahati, Dibrugarh**.
